name: address_pr_reply
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

prNumber.description: Pull request number referenced in the composed reply text.

head.description: Branch name reported in the reply's engine/branch footer.

proposalText.description: Summary text describing the proposed fix; a placeholder is used when absent.

subtasks.description: Subtasks addressed, rendered as a bulleted '- **id**: description' list.

findings.description: Verification findings, rendered as a bulleted list.

verified.description: Whether verification passed; rendered literally as 'true'/'false' in the reply.

reply.description: Composed Markdown reply body posted after addressing PR review feedback.
